verdict.rationale: GrowthBook says it is open source, and its docs describe self-hosting the whole stack (MongoDB, API, front-end) via Docker Compose, plus a self-hosted Proxy that caches SDK payloads. The docs also state that targeting attribute values are never sent to GrowthBook and stay in memory in the SDK. A community user confirms running the self-hosted version for months on their own click-stream data rather than sending it to third parties. Missing for 10: clarity on whether paid-tier features (approval workflows, SSO/SCIM, audit logs) are included in the open-source self-hosted distribution, and documented non-Docker deployment options (a community user asked for this, and others flagged the MongoDB dependency as an operational burden).
